<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern: a strong M+2 peak at ~33% of the base peak indicates chlorine (35Cl/37Cl). The M+1 peak at ~10% suggests carbon (13C) presence. No other characteristic patterns (e.g., Br 1:1, S low‑intensity M+2) are evident. Therefore, the elements that can be definitively identified are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
